title: Restriction augmentation square
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $U_i$ any family of opens, $I,J$ injective resolutions of abelian sheaves, and $\varphi:I^\bullet\to J^\bullet$ any cochain map. Write $S$ for its section map [def-pc-abelian-cech-sections-map], $T$ for its total map [def-pc-abelian-cech-total-map], and $\alpha_I,\alpha_J$ for the restriction augmentations [def-pc-abelian-cech-comparison-construction]. Then $T\circ\alpha_I=\alpha_J\circ S$. No covering hypothesis is needed.

source.place: Lemma 20.11.2, augmentation construction and omitted coefficient functoriality; Tag 01FD comparison diagram; explicit formal verification using the Mathlib APIs named in the proof

proof.text: In each degree, the total-map summand formula reduces the equality to restrictions commuting with the coefficient map. Apply presheaf naturality to the inclusion of each finite tuple intersection into the whole space. Cochain morphism extensionality gives equality.

lean.statement:
theorem abelianCechAlpha_square
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u} (U : ι → X.Opens)
    {F G : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}}
    {I : InjectiveResolution F} {J : InjectiveResolution G}
    (φ : I.cocomplex ⟶ J.cocomplex) :
    abelianCechAlpha U I ≫ abelianCechTotalMap U φ =
      abelianCechSectionsMap φ ≫ abelianCechAlpha U J
